text:
sam-sales: Quick sync — Copperlane POC kickoff. Need alignment on scope, acceptance gates, golden prompts, security Qs, timeline, and a rough pricing ask. Can we lock this today?

anita-se: working off the doc we shared earlier. main use case = invoice extraction + follow-up Q&A.

ryan-ps: for pricing they asked if hosted API with burst/dedicated reserved is supported — they expect ~20 QPS peak, 5 QPS steady. what's the recommended config?

omar-infra: for 20 QPS at 512-token avg we recommend Dedicated small pool (2x A10G equiv) or hosted with reserved throughput. estimate: ~$18k/mo on Dedicated commit, hosted would be slightly higher. i can run a cost sim.

liz-solutions: acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) extraction F1 >= 0.88 on golden set, 2) QA accuracy (human eval) >= 85%, 3) 95th perc latency <= 350ms in dedicated env, 4) no PII leakage in sample tests. Thoughts?

maya-sec: security red flags from their questionnaire: they want EKM/HSM integration, audit logs retained 12 months, and SOC2 evidence. We can support KMS/HSM in Private or Dedicated with a few caveats. Need to confirm network topology for on-prem connectors.

sam-sales: maya, can you list the exact Qs we need from Copperlane to close the sec row? i'll add to the RACI.

maya-sec: sure — network CIDR for allowlist, expected data flows, whether PHI/PII present, required retention, and do they need BYOK? also ask if penetration test report is required.

anita-se: on the evaluation harness: propose golden set = 150 labeled invoices (varied formats), regression set = 1k unlabeled + 200 human-annotated for spot checks. scoring: extraction = token-level F1, QA = pairwise human pass/fail. nightly regression run, alert if F1 drops > 4% absolute.

ryan-ps: can we make the golden set synthetic/augmented for edge cases or must be real customer data?

liz-solutions: prefer redacted real samples for fidelity. we can augment but keep at least 80 real docs in goldens. add a few multi-page and scanned-image OCR variants.

omar-infra: for the harness infra, i'll provision a staging cluster with same runtime config as Dedicated. deploy-bot will spin up pool and expose endpoints for eval.

deploy-bot: staging env for copperlane-poc available at https://staging.copperlane.redwood.internal — creds in 1Password

sam-sales: timeline ask from Copperlane — 4 week POC. Week 0 = data intake & sec Qs, week 1 = golden set + baseline, week 2 = model tuning & infra, week 3 = run regressions + human eval, week 4 = wrap and acceptance. can we commit?

anita-se: doable if we get data samples by EOD Tue. human evalers booked for week 3.

maya-sec: i'll send the minimal sec checklist to sam and ryen-ps now.

ryan-ps: pricing note to share with customer: hosted trial (metered) -> estimated $8-12k for 4 weeks; Dedicated trial (reserved) -> one-time prorated commit ~$6k + usage; exact numbers after infra sim from omar.

liz-solutions: acceptance gate details for regression: - run nightly eval, - compare new model vs baseline on golden set, - require no statistically significant drop (p>0.05) and absolute F1 delta >= -0.04 triggers rollback.

sam-sales: love that. last blocker: Copperlane asked about data residency in eu-central. can Dedicated be deployed in that region?

omar-infra: yes, we have dedicated pools in eu-central; if they pick Private we can run on their VPC in eu-central as well.

sam-sales: next steps: 1) sam to send aligned timeline + sec checklist to customer (today), 2) omar to run cost sim & confirm eu-central capacity (by EOD), 3) anita/liz to finalize golden prompt templates and seed set format (Mon), 4) maya to validate questionnaire gaps (today).

liz-solutions: i'll paste a sample prompt format here for the golden set:```
SYSTEM: You are an invoice parsing assistant. Extract: invoice_number, date, total, vendor_name, line_items (description, qty, price).
USER: <raw_invoice_text_or_ocr>
ASSISTANT: {"invoice_number": "", "date": "", "total": "", "vendor_name": "", "line_items": []}
```

sam-sales: perfect. i'll follow up with the Copperlane AE and get the data intake request out now. :thumbsup: :eyes:

maya-sec: ping me if they insist on penetration test report — that will add ~2 weeks.

anita-se: noted. we'll tag regressions and set up dashboards in Console for per-field F1 and latency.

sam-sales: thanks everyone — meeting in #copperlane-poc tomorrow 10am to kick off.
